name: n8n-estate-graph
description: Map every n8n workflow you run (one instance or many clients) into a dependency graph of credentials, webhooks, sheets, hosts and sub-workflow calls, then ask what breaks if X dies.
author: Waseem Nasir <waseem@skynetjoe.com> (https://skynetjoe.com)

scripts.demo: node bin/n8n-estate-graph.js build --from-dir examples/workflows/acme-dental --label acme-dental --from-dir examples/workflows/bali-villas --label bali-villas --out examples/sample-out --date 2026-11-02
